goldman.title: Associate Software Engineer
goldman.details:
Goldman Sachs is hiring for the role of Associate-Software Engineering!

Responsibilities of the Candidate:

  • Proactive management of our production services by measuring and monitoring availability, capacity and overall system health.
  • Shaping software before go-live through activities such as system design consulting, capacity planning and launch reviews.
  • Scaling and evolving systems by pushing for changes that improve capacity and reliability.
  • Practicing sustainable incident management in a blameless postmortem culture.
  • Identifying and building improvements to system behavior, control and monitoring tools.
  • Defining and maintaining Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to quantify and manage service reliability.
  • Engineering solutions to reduce "toil" through advanced automation and self-healing system capabilities.
  • Conducting capacity modeling and performance tuning to ensure systems meet future demand.

Requirements:

  • Experience in one or more of the following: Java, Python and Perl.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly express ideas and arguments.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with appreciation of technical risk.
  • Experience with automated testing and SDLC concepts, developing applications in a Linux environment, and sound knowledge of algorithms, data structures and software design.
  • Systematic problem-solving approach and a sense of ownership and drive.
  • Ability to debug and optimize code and to automate routine tasks.
  • Proficiency with Observability stacks, including distributed tracing, logging, and metrics (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry).
  • Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Knowledge of networking protocols and load balancing strategies in a distributed systems environment.

fresher_job.title: Software Developer
fresher_job.details:
Mellow Vault is hiring for Software Developer

About the Company:

Mellow Vault is building a next-generation technology and talent ecosystem focused on scalable software solutions and high-performance code. The team works across web development, cloud technologies, and modern software engineering stacks to create reliable digital products. This opportunity is designed for fresh graduates who want to begin their careers by solving meaningful engineering problems and learning from experienced teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Write clean, maintainable, efficient code using Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, or related technologies.
  • Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of APIs, web applications, and data services.
  • Debug defects, investigate technical issues, and contribute to application performance improvements.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX designers, QA engineers, product managers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver quality software modules.
  • Learn and apply modern frameworks, development tools, version-control practices, and Agile methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Strong fundamentals in Data Structures and Algorithms and Object-Oriented Programming.
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming language such as Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, or Node.js.
  • Basic understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, web development, or frameworks such as React, Vue, or Angular.
  • Familiarity with SQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Git, GitHub, and RESTful APIs is beneficial.
  • Applicants should demonstrate problem-solving ability, willingness to learn, attention to code quality, and effective communication.

wfh_job.title: Graduate Software Engineer
wfh_job.details:
Canonical is hiring for the role of Graduate Software Engineer!

Responsibilities of the Candidate:

  • Shape the product roadmap during global in-person sprints every six months and focus on design, user experience, and developer tooling.
  • Write high-quality, resilient, and performant code in languages such as Python, Rust, C/C++, Golang, JavaScript, or Bash.
  • Engage with users and the open-source community through code reviews, issue trackers, and customer issue resolution.
  • Work across various layers of the Linux system—from low-level boot loaders, kernels, and drivers to cloud applications, containers, and Kubernetes clusters.

Requirements:

  • Exceptional academic track record from high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in the year 2025 or 2026 in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics or another STEM discipline with programming courses 
  • Confidence to write high-quality code in Python, Rust, C/C++, Golang, JavaScript, or Java, along with familiarity with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution.
  • Personal projects in technology and software engineering beyond the curriculum.
  • Professional written and spoken English, strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, and accountability.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company sprints.

experienced_only.title: Senior Software Engineer
experienced_only.details:
TBO is hiring Senior Software Engineer!

About the Company:

TBO is a global platform that aims to simplify all buying and selling travel needs of travel partners across the world. The proprietary technology platform aims to simplify the demands of the complex world of global travel by seamlessly connecting the highly distributed travel buyers and travel suppliers at scale.

Why TBO:

  • You will influence & contribute to “Building World Largest Technology Led Travel Distribution Network” for a $ 9 Trillion global travel business market.
  • We are the emerging leaders in technology led end-to-end travel management, in the B2B space.
  • Physical Presence in 47 countries with business in 110 countries.
  • We are reputed for our-long lasting trusted relationships. We stand by our eco system of suppliers and buyers to service the end customer.
  • An open & informal start-up environment which cares.

What TBO offers to a Life Traveller in You:

  • Enhance Your Leadership Acumen. Join the journey to create global scale and ‘World Best’.
  • Challenge Yourself to do something path breaking. Be Empowered. The only thing to stop you will be your imagination.
  • Post pandemic: travel space is likely to see significant growth. Witness and shape this space. It will be one exciting journey.
  • As a fastest growing B2B platform our priority is purpose-building scalable systems.
  • Adopting industry leading technologies to support best-in-class business capabilities for high performing and scalable solutions.
  • Fast response to the evolving regulatory environment and helping to meet the firm's regulatory commitments by addressing internal and external commitments.

Top Sights During Your Role Stay (Key Expectations):

  • Strong programming experience with good grasp of scalability and performance
  • 3-7 years of experience building consumer facing platforms.
  • Strong grasp of distributed systems and system design.
  • High degree of ownership
  • Ability to pick up and learn new programming languages and frameworks
  • Strong problem solving ability and focus on innovation
  • Prior experience with serverless technologies is desirable
  • Exposure to languages/ framworks like GoLang, RUST ,Java,Python, Node
  • Capacity to use SQL server with ease. Exposure to Redis / MongoDB/ PostgreSQL is desired.
  • Should have worked with cloud platforms like AWS / Azure.
  • A flair for creating well-presented software that is technically sound.
  • Outstanding analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Self-driven, flexible, and innovative.

Role Details:

  • Eligible Branches: B.Tech – Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), or Software Engineering only
  • Passing Batch: 2026 TIER 1 College Only

Selection Process:

  • Technical Assessment

  • Technical Interview – Round 1

     

  • Technical Interview – Round 2

     

  • Technical Interview – Round 3

     

  • HR Interview

network_function.title: Network (Support) Engineer
network_function.details:
Job Overview:

  • We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Network Engineer (Fresher) to join our IT Infrastructure team.
  • The candidate will assist in managing, monitoring, and troubleshooting network systems to ensure secure and uninterrupted connectivity across the organisation.
  • This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about networking technologies and eager to build a career in IT infrastructure and network security.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the installation, configuration, and maintenance of routers, switches, firewalls, and other network devices.
  • Monitor network performance and resolve connectivity-related issues.
  • Support LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and internet connectivity operations.
  • Help maintain network security, access control, and user connectivity.
  • Configure IP addressing, VLANs, and basic routing/switching tasks.
  • Respond to network support tickets and provide technical assistance to users.
  • Maintain network documentation, asset inventory, and configuration records.
  • Coordinate with senior engineers during network upgrades and implementations.
  • Ensure network uptime, stability, and performance standards are maintained.

Required Skills:

  • Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, subnetting, and routing.
  • Familiarity with routers, switches, and firewall concepts.
  • Knowledge of Windows and Linux networking fundamentals.
  • Basic troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s  Engineering in  Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, or related field.
  • Certifications such as CCNA, Network+, or equivalent will be an added advantage.

Preferred Qualities:

  • Passion for learning networking technologies and tools.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic awareness of cybersecurity and network security practices.

internship.title: Frontend Developer Internship
internship.details:
About the Company

NeerajPharma is inviting applications for a Frontend Developer Intern to join its technology team. The internship offers freshers an opportunity to build practical web development experience while working remotely in a structured, collaborative environment. Interns will receive exposure to real-world interface development, product thinking, debugging, and online teamwork.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with creating responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
  • Translate design concepts and requirements into reusable frontend components.
  • Support debugging, testing, browser compatibility checks, and interface improvements.
  • Participate in code reviews, documentation, and virtual team discussions.
  • Learn and apply modern frontend development practices under team guidance.

Requirements

  • Open to freshers and candidates beginning their career in technology.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design, and web development concepts.
  • Interest in learning frontend frameworks, development tools, and user experience principles.
  • Strong willingness to learn, problem-solving ability, and clear communication.
  • Ability to work independently from home and collaborate effectively with a remote team.

This is a 6-week unpaid internship for candidates seeking hands-on experience in frontend development within a technology-focused organization.

internship_titled_job.title: Associate Software Engineer Internship
internship_titled_job.details:
Kaleris is hiring for the role of Associate Software Engineer Intern!

Responsibilities of the Candidate:

  • Analyze functional requirements, design and develop software programs to specifications 

  • Provide technical support for both new and existing product features 

  • Design & maintain user interfaces, algorithms, data structures, test cases, and test suites for new/old functional modules of Kaleris products 

  • Communicate status of ongoing development efforts to supervisors in India & USA

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in Engineering or Computer Science  

  • Excellent Object-Oriented programming skills and accomplished performance technologies

  • Highly proficient in debugging preferably using Visual Studio & Code Warrior IDEs  

  • Capable of identifying and automating unit/functional tests using any standard or proprietary tool  

  • Strong analytical abilities and debugging/troubleshooting skills  

  • Proficient in both verbal and written communication abilities 

  • Source code control systems such as SVN, CVS, VSS or equivalent a plus  

  • Exposure to logistics, container terminals/management is highly preferred  

  • Experience or knowledge of real time graphical application development is a great addition
